scope: Current-source technical installation, ordinary-route and visual no-regression review for this ownership/interaction batch only. Exhaustive UV/PBR/mipmap qualification is evaluated separately from the loaded inventory. This is no human, photoreal, final appearance or whole-V2 acceptance. Unchanged native asset/material fabrication checks are reused; open visible defects remain open.

images.observation: Reviewed current composition from the registered portal frame: clear open entrance, retained throat and lit shopfront axis. Coarse repeated portal brick relief and sparse frame detail remain open appearance defects; no photoreal acceptance.

Reviewed actual hall after the continuous played route: retained shop/counter/cart geometry and clock axis are present with clear centre circulation. Flat awning/fascia stock and repeated exposed masonry remain open.

Reviewed actual covered return: lapped overhead stock, side planks, post-to-beam bearings and closure remain fitted. The path stops before the closure. Timber repetition remains visible and unresolved.

Current native wardrobe remains separate from the installed wall finishes, floor and adjoining furniture. Existing wood finish and window-treatment appearance are unchanged; this is a placement/no-regression check.
Current hanging toolboard clears the eye rail while retaining its wall plane and the bench/lamp arrangement below. No visible rail penetration. Flat light/pale wood response remains appearance work.

Current source-fitted four-face clock and campaign hands remain mounted under the lantern in the retained frame. Numerals, glazing, eased rims and hand separation remain readable. This review reuses unchanged native fabrication proof and does not approve the broader hall finishes.

Actual underside remains closed and fitted beneath the clock. Retained coarse mottled hanger/finial is still an explicit geometry/finish defect for the next native pass; it has not been accepted as polished.
